units: <cite ref="Megillah 13a:11">Meg. 13ᵃ</cite> (play on <cite ref="A02586"><he>אסתר</he></cite>) <he>שהיתה מְסַתֶּרֶת דבריה</he> she used her words with discretion (ref. to <cite ref="Esther 2:20">Esth. II, 20</cite>); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 1053">Yalk. Esth. 1053</cite> (not <he>שסתרת</he>).—Part. pass. <cite ref="M01874"><he>מְסוּתָּר</he></cite>; pl. <he>מְסוּתָּרִים</he>.
<cite ref="Avot D'Rabbi Natan 6:2">Ab. d’R. N. ch. VI</cite> <he>דברים המס׳ מבניִ אדם הוציאם וכ׳</he> things which are concealed to men, R. ‘Akiba brought forth to the light.
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 941:5">Yalk. Deut. 941</cite> <he>אע״פ שהִסְתַּרְתִּי פני וכ׳</he> although I hide my face before them, I will speak to him in a dream.

senses.gloss: to be hidden, protected; to hide one’s self.
units: Midr. Till. to Ps. XIX, 7 לע״ל מי נִסְתָּר מחמתו וכ׳ in the future who will be protected from his heat?—Esp. to retire under suspicious circumstances (Num. V, 13).

<cite ref="Sotah 3a:5">Sot. 3ᵃ</cite> <he>קינא לה ונִסְתָּרָה</he> he was jealous of her (forewarned her), and she retired (with the man). Y. ib. I, 16ᵇ bot. <he>מה טיבה להִיסָּתֵר</he> what business had she to retire? Bab.

<cite ref="Sotah 5b:6">ib. 5ᵇ</cite> <he>אל תִּסָּתְרִי</he> do not hide thyself (with that man); <cite ref="Sotah 2b:27">ib. 2ᵇ</cite> (in Chald. dict.) <he>לא תִיסָּתְרִי וכ׳</he> do not hide thyself with that man.
<cite ref="Berakhot 31b:10">Ber. 31ᵇ</cite> <he>אלך ואֶסְתַּתֵּר וכ׳</he> I will go and seclude myself (with a man) before my husband.
Ib. אם כן ילכו … ויִסְתַּתְּרוּ if this be so, all childless women would go and hide themselves; a. fr.—נִסְתָּרוֹת f.pl.

<cite ref="Chagigah 13a:2">Ḥag. 13ᵃ</cite> (fr. Ben Sira) <he>אין לך עסק בנ׳</he> thou must have nothing to do with (must not speculate on) mysteries; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 8">Gen. R. s. 8</cite>; a. e.—
senses.label: a

senses.gloss: secret sins for which the whole community is made responsible.
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 43b:11">Snh. 43ᵇ</cite> <he>לא ענש על הנ׳ וכ׳</he> the Lord did not punish (Israel) for secret sins until &c. Y. Sot. VII, end, 22ᵃ <he>אין לכם עסק בנ׳</he> you will no more be made responsible for undetected sins.
senses.label: b
